claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show visible dark stains and soiling on the seat and backrest.

risks.risk: Structural damage to the internal frame
risks.proof: A photo of the underside or a video of the sofa being shaken/sat upon.
A video showing a hand pressing into the seat and backrest to see the rebound.
Close-up video of the seams and the underside of the sofa.

risks.if_unproven: as requiring professional deep cleaning and potential reupholstery

proof_requests: Clear photo of the underside of the sofa.
Video demonstrating the firmness of the cushions.
Close-up shots of the seams to check for pests.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a 2-seater sofa. Although the seller's claim of it being 'neat' is contradicted by visible stains, it can be priced at its worst-case condition for cleaning and structural integrity.
